reason: The image-only reading left the cut line ends and many abbreviations uncertain, and the source supplied the lost words, the expansions and the order of the strips.
sources: Petrus Comestor, Historia scholastica, Liber III Regum cap. 29-37, PL 198 (Paris, 1855), cols. 1373-1381, archive.org patrologiaecursu0198mign n692, n693, n694, n696 (page images)
text:
Source-assisted reading of Stams, Frg. 103 (F-wgga), made with PL 198, cols. 1373-1381 (Petrus Comestor, Historia scholastica, III Reg. cap. 29-37) available. A research reader reread on the native images: canvas 0 strip 1 right column (box 1600,2350,2400,3480), canvas 0 strip 4 right column (box 6000,1330,6900,2400), canvas 1 strip 4 left column (box 5600,1250,6450,2350) and the upper lines of canvas 1 strip 1 left column (box 1380,1300,2150,2400). All other column pieces rest on the image-only first reading. Strips are numbered 1-4 from the left of each image. Expansions in parentheses; ? = uncertain; [..] = lost at the cut or unread; [x] = supplied from PL.
